description:
Há mais de 28 anos, o Grupo CET LOGISTICS está presente no Comércio Exterior tendo iniciado suas atividades no segmento de Óleo e Gás, especializando-se em grandes projetos e, atualmente, é especializado também em logística integrada e internacional em transporte de mercadorias multimodal, presente nas áreas comerciais mais importantes do mundo.

O Grupo está envolvido em projetos globais para as mais diversas indústrias, desenvolvendo serviços porta a porta que incluem: coleta de carga em sua origem, planejamento estratégico, distribuição, rastreamento, expedição e desembaraço aduaneiro.

Nos últimos anos, a CET expandiu significativamente sua área de especialização, com grande knowhow e uma excelente reputação no mercado, oferecendo a seus clientes soluções personalizadas em toda a cadeia logística, com qualidade, agilidade, responsabilidade e transparência. Nossos escritórios e hubs estão situados no Rio de Janeiro/Brasil, Houston/EUA e Roterdã/Holanda.

Hoje a CET atende sua base de clientes com mais de 250 especialistas em logística presentes em diferentes regiões do globo.

Conheça mais sobre a CET LOGISTICS e todos os nossos serviços no site:

Descrição de atividades:

· Elaborar propostas comerciais e cálculos de frete para clientes estratégicos, baseando-se em análises de custo, capacidade operacional e viabilidade econômica;

· Desenvolver, manter e aprimorar ferramentas de simulação de preços e margens, garantindo maior agilidade e assertividade na formação de preços;

· Realizar análises comparativas de mercado (benchmarking) e estudos de sensibilidade para embasar decisões de revisão de tabelas tarifárias;

· Acompanhar indicadores de rentabilidade por cliente, rota e tipo de serviço, propondo ajustes quando necessário;

· Suportar o time comercial em negociações, fornecendo análises de impacto financeiro e cenários alternativos de pricing;

· Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas como Operações, Financeiro, Fiscal e TI para garantir que os preços estejam aderentes aos custos e regras tributárias;

· Avaliar contratos existentes e sugerir revisões com base em performance, reajustes e desvios de rentabilidade;

· Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de precificação e implantação de práticas de pricing dinâmico, sempre que possível;

· Liderar projetos de reestruturação de pricing ou análise de novos modelos de negócio.

Competências:

· Pensamento crítico: questiona, analisa e recalcula;

· Comunicação clara e firme: sabe traduzir planilha para quem vive na estrada;

· Agilidade e organização: lida com prazos apertados, mas entrega com exatidão;

· Influência e negociação: sabe dizer "não" com fundamento e apresentar alternativas viáveis;

· Curiosidade e melhoria contínua: busca sempre como precificar melhor e mais rápido.

Requirements

· Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Logística, Economia ou áreas correlatas;

· Excel avançado; domínio de ferramentas como Power BI, Access, VBA ou SQL é um diferencial;

· Conhecimento profundo em custos logísticos, tabelas de frete, modais (rodoviário, aéreo, marítimo), impostos (ICMS, ISS, etc.);

· Experiência prévia sólida em precificação de serviços logísticos ou transporte de cargas;

Benefits

  • 25% travel - mostly within North and South America.

• Providenciar a limpeza da sala.
• Zelar por todo material e equipamento dentro da unidade e, se necessário, providenciar conserto.

title: Data Governance Specialist
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose


  • As a Data Governance Specialist, you develop and implement data governance policies and procedures. Support defining data quality, compliance, and data security across the organization. Collaborate with stakeholders to establish best practices and improve data management and integrity.

    • Responsibilities


  • Develop and implement data governance frameworks, policies, and procedures to ensure data integrity, security, and quality.
  • Collaborate with data stewards, data owners, and business stakeholders to define data standards and guidelines.
  • Monitor and enforce compliance with data governance policies across the organization.
  • Conduct regular data audits to identify and address data quality issues.
  • Provide guidance and support to data users on data governance best practices.
  • Maintain and update data governance documentation, including data dictionaries and metadata repositories.
  • Manage data governance tools and platforms to support data governance activities.
  • I dentify opportunities for improving data management processes and recommend solutions.
  • Coordinate with IT and data management teams to ensure data governance requirements are integrated into system development and maintenance.
  • Facilitate data governance training and awareness programs for employees.
  • Report on data governance metrics and performance to senior management.
  • Lead data governance working groups and committees to drive data governance initiatives.
  • Support the development and implementation of data governance strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Foster a culture of data governance and stewardship within the organization.

    • Education


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is required. Certifications such as ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library), PMP (Project Management Professional), or AWS Certified Solutions Architect, demonstrating expertise in data governance and management, are preferred. Proficiency in English is essential for effective communication with team members, stakeholders, and external vendors. A Master's Degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

    • Experience


  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in data governance, data management, or a related field, with at least 2 years in a leadership or managerial role.
  • Proven experience in developing and implementing data governance strategies and frameworks.
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience in designing, implementing, and managing complex data infrastructures, including cloud environments and data integration.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and enforce data governance standards, guidelines, and best practices to ensure data quality, security, and compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with data governance tools and frameworks such as Collibra, Informatica, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of data privacy laws and regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and their application in data governance.
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and collaborating with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership and team-building skills, with a passion for developing and mentoring talent.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English is mandatory.
  • Attributes such as team spirit, problem-solving, creative thinking, and proactivity are essential.

    • Functional Competencies


    Compliance Governance, Risk and Control Analytics and reporting IT Tools and application Cost and budget control Business Partnering Digital savvy Business Acumen Contract Management Management of change application

    GENERAL INFORMATION

    SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group ("the Company"). For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

A Zerezes nasceu do design, e da vontade de fazer diferente. A gente acredita que óculos são mais do que itens funcionais: são extensão de quem somos. Por isso, queremos transformar a forma como as pessoas se relacionam com eles.

Aqui, cada pessoa conta. E a gente cresce junto, com transparência, impacto real e vontade de fazer bonito, sempre.

Fazer coisas memoráveis.

A gente gosta de fazer diferente, com criatividade, impacto real e propósito.

Somos curiosos por natureza. Escutamos, testamos, ajustamos e seguimos em frente.

Transparência radical.

Falamos com clareza e respeito. O combinado não sai caro, e o feedback aqui é ferramenta de crescimento.

Tratar os outros como gostaríamos de ser tratados.

Empatia e escuta são base de tudo. A gente constrói junto e valoriza cada ponto de vista.

Bom para o mundo.

Nosso impacto vai além dos óculos. Queremos gerar valor pra quem tá com a gente, seja dentro ou fora da Zerezes.

Vamos juntos?

Se você acredita que trabalho pode ser leve sem deixar de ser sério, que dá pra fazer bonito sem perder a simplicidade, e que ótica pode ser muito mais do que só vender óculos…

A Zerezes pode ser o seu lugar

Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente

  • Alimentar planilhas ou sistemas de controle com dados coletados conforme demanda, mantendo as informações atualizadas e acessíveis para tomada de decisão.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Conhecimento do pacote office;

Desde então, somos uma das principais empresas do setor no país e estamos presentes em seis estados brasileiros (Alagoas, Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro e Sergipe), beneficiando milhões de pessoas com os serviços prestados por nossas concessões e parcerias público-privadas. Mais do que uma atividade empresarial, encaramos a universalização do saneamento básico como um compromisso de larga escala com a vida, as pessoas, o meio ambiente, os parceiros e o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil.

O nosso jeito de ser é marcado pelo DNA inovador que proporciona um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e de muitos aprendizados, gerando grande impacto na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito as diferenças estão presentes na empresa para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independente de suas crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. The Toloka Annotators platform connects individuals with Generative AI projects from leading tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the full potential of AI by involving real people from around the world in the development process.

About the Role

Annotation is what helps AI make sense of the world — it's the bridge between raw data and intelligent understanding. As a Senior Data Annotator, you'll play a key role in shaping how AI systems interpret language, images, and information. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, provide feedback on data quality, and help maintain high annotation standards across diverse projects.

Responsibilities:

  • Review and analyze data — from text passages and product descriptions to social media posts, news articles, or visual content (such as marketing images and short videos) — ensuring it's correctly labeled and contextually accurate.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) checks on tasks completed by other annotators, identifying inconsistencies or labelling errors, and providing constructive feedback to help improve accuracy.
  • Label or classify content according to detailed project guidelines — for example, tagging sentiment in user reviews, identifying medical terminology in clinical texts, or categorizing tone in marketing copy.
  • Evaluate AI-generated content by rating response quality, factual correctness, and tone appropriateness — such as comparing different chatbot outputs or fact-checking generated summaries.
  • Flag problematic or sensitive material, including biased language, misleading claims, or inappropriate visual content, to ensure compliance with ethical and safety standards.
  • Contribute to process improvements, such as suggesting refinements to annotation guidelines, improving workflow efficiency, and mentoring new team members on best practices.

Important note: This is project-based work. Tasks are available only when projects are active. You may be invited to one or more projects depending on your profile and current opportunities.

  • You hold or are currently pursuing a Bachelor/Master/PhD Degree in any professional field.
  • You have advanced proficiency in Korean (C1) and at least English (B2), both written and spoken.
  • Experience in mentoring/teaching/consulting, or editing/reviewing/consulting work in a professional or academic setting.
  • Excellent written communication and ability to give clear, structured and constructive feedback
  • Proven experience in annotation or data labelling.
  • Attention to details and ability to understand and follow instructions.
  • Genuine interest in technology and artificial intelligence.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $9/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

title: Embedded IoT
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representatives, Managers, and Directors to expand our reach in mission-critical industries such as Automotive, Medical Devices, Industrial Systems, Robotics, and Telco, as well as consumer electronics. We are looking for candidates who are technically skilled and familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS. We are expanding in all time zones, so we can accommodate candidates from almost any country as long as they have reasonable business access to a substantial market territory in person. As we grow our teams, we will also hire Sales Team Managers and Regional Sales Directors. Please continue with this process if your goal is a management leadership position.

The server edition of Ubuntu is already very widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer edition of Ubuntu for IoT, called Ubuntu Core, represents the state of the art in security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment. Our customers include global brands in consumer and industrial electronics, as well as automotive and robotics. We continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management, and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. We recently added a real-time Linux capability and are working towards a range of certifications for these offerings. Together, this portfolio is Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint.

This is a prospecting sales and strategic account development role and requires energy, ambition, and focus. To be successful, you must be comfortable positioning and selling open source, services, and software solutions to all levels of an organization, and specifically to departments that are developing embedded software and IoT devices. You should also be familiar with at least one of our priority sectors.

Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute, and every category of application. Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting, and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote, and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position; it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision-making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long-term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world-leading company, we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment that promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration, and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted, which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with brands in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement, and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgment as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete, and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies, and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location: We are growing our sales reach in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas.

The role entails

  • Building and executinge a territory plan to prioritize leading security-focused brands and manufacturers
  • Working with marketing to promote our brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts
  • Developing pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Closinge contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets and achieve strategic objectives
  • Managinge customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Working with IoT Field Engineers to understand customer requirements and ensure customer satisfaction
  • Maintaining accurate data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establishing productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision-makers
  • Coordinatinge with colleagues, including support, delivery, and management

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Field sales experience in embedded Linux, embedded software, or enterprise software
  • Track record of achievement of sales targets and large account wins
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer meetings and industry events
  • Ability to develop and execute territory sales plans
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up

What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu.

Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Ubuntu is easy to deploy and configure, one node at a time, but it's difficult to know where you stand on policy and compliance, patch management, or access control across a large estate. Ubuntu used to be under the radar in the enterprise, but it is now becoming an official platform for many companies. Those enterprises very much want a high quality way to manage their Ubuntu estate.

We started work on Landscape many years ago, and the current generation of the service reflects the choices of the day. We now have the opportunity to invest significantly in a team to bring a fresh new vision for large-scale Ubuntu estate management to the project. That doesn't make this a greenfield opportunity - we have a system that serves thousands of deployments - but we know we want to step back and give it a big new push, letting go of some things that are no longer so important, and embracing a range of new priorities. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.

Today we use Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, HAProxy, and have a ReactJS front end. In other web services projects we use more Golang these days. Our next wave of Landscape engineering is an opportunity to raise the bar on SAAS and on-prem solution technologies, architectures, patterns and operations. Our goal is to make it easy for enterprises to own a few Landscape instances that serve their global estate, and to be able to apply policy and know intuitively where they stand - globally - in a very complex world of mixed Ubuntu versions, substrates and flavours.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of their teams. You will work closely with product managers, and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. A successful applicant will be capable of growing a team of engineers, collaborating with other engineering and business teams at Canonical, and providing periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your region
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel 4-6 weeks per year for internal and external events

Valued skills and experience

  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect
description:
The
OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect
is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third-party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICS).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic vision
  • Problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

  • Coordenar testes de desempenho complexos, garantindo a validação efetiva dos equipamentos de processo para garantir condições ideais de serviço.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de crescimento alinhadas à visão de longo prazo, considerando desenvolvimentos futuros nas instalações.
  • Oferecer suporte técnico avançado de campo, resolvendo problemas complexos e orientando a equipe de operações em cálculos técnicos avançados.
  • Conduzir pesquisas e inovações para introduzir tecnologias de ponta e práticas inovadoras nos processos de produção.
  • Elaborar relatórios estratégicos de projetos de melhorias nas instalações, apresentando-os a órgãos reguladores e lideranças internas.
  • Supervisionar e garantir a governança documental, assegurando a precisão e atualização dos DSO e DUT das instalações.
  • Utilizar técnicas avançadas de modelagem para monitorar e simular operações, identificando oportunidades para eficiência e redução de custos.
  • Desenvolver estratégias para gestão de crises e conflitos com partes interessadas, mantendo a continuidade operacional e reduzindo impactos.
  • Integrar práticas sustentáveis nos processos, garantindo conformidade com normas ambientais e promovendo a responsabilidade social corporativa.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Superior completo em Engenharia Química.
  • Ampla experiência na área de processos em óleo & gás;
  • Experiência com uso de simulador de processos;
  • Conhecimentos | Habilidades | Experiência: Conhecimento nos softwares como: Wellflo, ReO, Hysys, Autocad.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de simulação de escoamento multifásico e análise nodal (ex.: PIPESIM, OLGA, PROSPER ou equivalentes)

title: Electrical Technician
description:
Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.


About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To


  • Electrical Supervisor

    • Background


  • The Technician is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
  • The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

    • Authority


  • The Electrical Technician is authorized to perform activities as per the level of Electrical Authorization granted by the UEA or Fleet Electrical Assessor.

    • Immediate Subordinates


  • Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendor Representatives.

    • Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards


  • 2) Maintain and adjust the condition of electrical assets:
  • Electrical Systems, Equipment, UPS Batteries, Generators Switchboards, Motors, Wiring, Portable tools etc.
  • 1 Comply with relevant authorization procedures, safe working practices and specific instructions.
  • 2
  • Complete maintenance and preservation in an agreed timescale, using safe and appropriate methods and agreed procedures.
  • 3 Ensure resources and spares are planned for and used cost effectively.
  • 4
  • Ensure the correct, current operating requirements are available for reference.
  • 5
  • Ensure any assets which have been maintained or had parameters adjusted still comply with specified operating requirements with minimum disruption and with the specified methods, tools and materials.
  • 6
  • Monitor and record any maintenance or adjustments accurately in work history in MMS.
  • 2) Monitor And Assess the Performance And Condition Of Electrical Assets.
  • 1 Obtain information or parameters from reliable sources (Inspection ports, connections, vendor documentary information, instrument readings, diagnostic equipment) using approved methods.
  • 2 Use monitoring equipment or procedures correctly to assess the condition of electrical assets.
  • 3 Ensure monitoring and checks are carried out in line with specified MMS timescales and schedules.
  • 4 Record and communicate monitored outcomes accurately and in timely fashion to raise the effectiveness of MMS.
  • 5 Compare current performance with previous assessments and act where differences must be addressed.
  • 3) Diagnose Faults in Electrical Assets.
  • 1 Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
  • 2 Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.
  • 3 Determine the cause, nature and extent of problems in the performance and condition of electrical systems or assets.
  • 4 Use the results of inspections to determine the appropriate actions to take.
  • 5 Record an accurate and full description in the appropriate document history.
  • 4) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures.
  • 1 Sample and check that controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits.
  • 2 Identify and halt unplanned discharges where possible, and reported immediately according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 4 Ensure resources such as PPE, materials, tools and spares are accounted and not wasted or used inefficiently.
  • 5) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

    • Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies


    Offshore - Isolation and Switching Procedures on HV/LV Distribution Boards Offshore - AC and DC UPS Systems Offshore - Electrical Test Equipment Offshore - Black Start and Power Outage Reinstatement Offshore - Hazardous Area Classification Offshore - Safety Management Offshore - Earthing and Bonding Offshore - HV/LV Transformers Offshore - Synchronising Generators Offshore - HV/LV Generation

    Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience


  • Once recruited, the Technician will be authorized by the UEA to the appropriate level.
  • Proven experience and qualified to ONC/ HNC, or NVQ Level 3 or recognized equivalent in Electrical Maintenance Engineering.
  • Experience preferred, with 2 years offshore petrochemical experience desired.
  • Good knowledge of PTW, Electrical Isolation Standards, Risk Assessment, Power Management System, Generation on LV.
  • COMP-EX Certified.
  • HV/LV Protection Relay and HVLV Switching.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

title: Economista
description:
Economista Jr | Lobie - Transformando Hospitalidade em Escala

Lobie
| Centro - Rio de Janeiro (Presencial)

O Desafio

Procuramos
2 economistas
para construir o cérebro analítico da operação. Você vai trabalhar diretamente com o CEO/CTO em projetos que definem como alocamos capital, precificamos ativos e escalamos o negócio:

Projetos reais que você vai tocar:

Inteligência de Mercado & Performance

  • Tracking de performance operacional (31 meses de histórico, 107 → 1165 unidades)
  • Benchmarking competitivo (yield, ocupação, ticket médio)
  • Construção de cenários para expansão geográfica e alocação de capital

Relações com Investidores

  • Elaboração de informes mensais para cotistas e investidores
  • Tradução de métricas operacionais em narrativa estratégica
  • Preparação de materiais para reuniões de board e apresentações institucionais
  • Monitoramento de KPIs e construção de dashboards executivos

Análise Econômico-Financeira

  • Valuation de portfólios e análise de oportunidades de aquisição
  • Modelagem DCF para investimentos em studios e conversões
  • ROI de reformas e CapEx por tipologia de imóvel
  • Análise de custos operacionais e otimização de margem

Suporte Estratégico

  • Apoio em decisões de alocação de capital (comprar x reformar x operar)
  • Análise de viabilidade econômica de novos projetos
  • Identificação de gargalos operacionais e oportunidades de eficiência

Quem Buscamos

Formação:
Economia (essencial) - cursando a partir do 4º período ou recém-formado

O que você precisa ter:

Raciocínio quantitativo forte
- você vê padrões em dados, não só números

Excel avançado
- tabelas dinâmicas, funções complexas, modelagem financeira

Comunicação clara
- transforma análise em insight acionável (oral e
escrito
)

Autonomia executiva
- não espera task list, vai atrás do problema

Resiliência analítica
- lida com dados bagunçados, premissas incertas, pivots rápidos

Diferenciais que amamos:

Python/R para análise de dados

Power BI, Looker ou ferramentas de visualização

Conhecimento de real estate, hospitalidade ou marketplace

Experiência com modelagem estatística (regressões, forecasting)

Habilidade em redação técnica e storytelling com dados

O que realmente importa:

  • Você pensa em sistemas, não em planilhas
  • entende que cada decisão afeta múltiplas variáveis
  • Executa rápido, itera mais rápido
  • prefere testar 80% correto hoje do que 100% perfeito nunca
  • Faz perguntas difíceis
  • questiona premissas, aponta riscos, propõe alternativas
  • Ownership total
  • trata o problema como seu, vai fundo até entregar solução
  • Escreve bem
  • sabe como contar uma história com dados para audiências diferentes

Mas o valor real está aqui:

  • Acesso direto ao CEO
    e decisões estratégicas da empresa
  • Projetos de impacto imediato
  • suas análises viram decisões de milhões em semanas
  • Experiência em Relações com Investidores
  • você vai escrever para e interagir com investidores reais
  • Curva de aprendizado vertical
  • hospitalidade + real estate + revenue management + finanças estruturadas
  • Portfólio real de trabalho
  • em 6 meses você tem cases concretos para qualquer entrevista futura
  • Ponte para ecossistema
  • Lobie faz parte do grupo HausBank (tokenização, DeFi, mercado de capitais)

Como se Candidatar

Envie para
(
;
)
com assunto
"Economista - Lobie"
:

1. CV objetivo (máx. 1 página)2. Mini-caso (escolha 1):

Opção A - Informe ao Investidor:

Você precisa escrever um informe mensal para investidores da Lobie. No mês, a ocupação caiu de 82% para 78%, mas a receita subiu 5%. Como você estruturaria esse comunicado para explicar o resultado de forma clara e estratégica? (Máx. 300 palavras)

Opção B - Decisão de Investimento:

Lobie tem R$ 5M para alocar. Opção 1: Comprar 20 studios prontos (yield 7%, gestão simples). Opção 2: Comprar 8 aptos grandes para converter em 32 studios (yield projetado 9%, mas exige reforma de 6 meses e R$ 800k). Como você estruturaria a análise dessa decisão?

Formato:
Máx. 500 palavras ou 1 página. Queremos ver clareza de raciocínio e estruturação, não decoreba.

Sobre Meritocracia

Valorizamos diversidade de trajetórias. Se você tem perfil analítico forte mas não marca todos os requisitos técnicos,
candidate-se mesmo assim
. Preferimos alto potencial e fome de aprender a currículo impecável.

Não contratamos por pedigree de faculdade - contratamos por capacidade de resolver problemas complexos.

Por que trabalhar na Lobie?

Não somos uma startup "hypada". Somos uma operação real, lucrativa, em escala, resolvendo problemas complexos de otimização econômica no mundo físico. Se você quer entender como decisões analíticas viram resultado concreto (ocupação, receita, margem)
e como comunicar isso para investidores sofisticados
, esse é o lugar.

Pronto para transformar dados em decisões que movem milhões?

Envie sua candidatura agora.

#Economia #RelaçõesComInvestidores #RealEstate #Hospitalidade #AnáliseDeDados #Trainee #RioDeJaneiro

title: Roaming IREG Engineer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.
Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.
We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards.
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators.
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements.
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity.
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team. 

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming).
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs.
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems.
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services).
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting.
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch.
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service.
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers.
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams.


Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills.
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: gerente de compliance
description:
Gerente de Compliance


MISSÃO DO CARGO

Garantir a conformidade legal e regulatória da organização por meio do desenvolvimento e implementação de programas eficazes de compliance, com foco em Anticorrupção, Direito da Concorrência e Controles de Comércio Exterior. Atuar na aplicação e monitoramento das normativas em todas as áreas do negócio, fornecendo orientação estratégica para mitigar riscos e assegurar boas práticas corporativas. Manter relacionamento ativo com autoridades brasileiras e órgãos reguladores, assegurando a transparência e integridade das operações. Promover a cultura ética dentro da organização por meio de treinamentos, auditorias e políticas de conformidade.


REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS


• Ensino superior completo em Direito, Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis.
• Pós-graduação ou MBA em Compliance, Governança ou Direito Público.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES


• Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Compliance: Atuar na criação e execução de medidas para um programa de conformidade eficaz, focado em Anticorrupção, Direito da Concorrência e Controles de Comércio Exterior. Garantir a aderência dos processos internos às regulamentações vigentes;
• Consultoria Interna: Auxiliar as áreas do negócio a respeito dos normativos internos, fornecendo orientação sobre questões de compliance. Propor soluções para as demandas de modo a mitigar eventuais riscos;
• Monitoramento e Revisão de Controles Internos: Avaliar continuamente os controles internos, monitorando a aderência das operações às normativas aplicáveis. Propor melhorias e ajustes para fortalecer a governança e minimizar riscos regulatórios;
• Elaboração e Revisão de Políticas de Integridade: Auxiliar na revisão periódica, bem como na elaboração de políticas e procedimentos do Programa de Integridade da empresa, de modo a garantir que todos os documentos estejam em conformidade com as legislações aplicáveis e necessidades da empresa;
• Avaliação de Riscos e Due Diligence: Auxiliar na condução de avaliações de risco corporativo conforme a Lei nº 12.846/2013, garantindo a validação da gerência da área. Executar due diligence em parceiros, fornecedores e terceiros para mitigar riscos de compliance;
• Suporte em Auditorias Internas e Externas: Atuar como referência técnica nas auditorias, preparando documentações e assegurando o cumprimento dos requisitos normativos. Apoiar a implementação de melhorias em resposta a eventuais não-conformidades;
• Treinamento e Capacitação em Compliance: Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos para colaboradores sobre normas, regulamentos e diretrizes do Programa de Integridade. Criar estratégias educacionais para promover a cultura ética na organização;
• Monitoramento da Conformidade com Regulamentos de Controle de Comércio Exterior: Acompanhar a aplicação dos requisitos regulatórios de controle de comércio exterior, de modo a assegurar que as operações estejam alinhadas às legislações nacionais e internacionais aplicáveis;
• Relatórios e Indicadores de Compliance: Elaborar relatórios anuais e periódicos com métricas do Programa de Integridade para a Alta Administração (Conselho e Diretoria) e eventuais outros stakeholders. Manter indicadores de performance dos pilares da área para garantir a melhoria contínua.

title: Principal Cost Controls Specialist
description:
Description

Job Overview:

The Principal Cost Controls Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices to improve cost and schedule. They will be tasked with solving complex cost management problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Cost Controls Specialist may be required to guide junior personnel. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in costing and broad knowledge of the costing discipline within the project controls function.



Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Implement McDermott processes and systems on projects.
  • Lead the project controls team on large and highly complex EPC projects.
  • Implement constructability concepts, (the how it's built) and related interdependencies between Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction in support of the Advanced Work Planning (AWP) process.
  • Support the development of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) on complex projects with multiple partners and compensation types.
  • Implement internal and contractual requirements on the project via the project controls execution plan.
  • Lead setup and implementation of project controls systems.
  • Responsible for the accuracy of project controls reports.
  • Analyze and interpret cost forecasting and trending.
  • Recommends solutions or recovery plans for problem areas.
  • Lead preparation and review of the project monthly forecast.
  • Support the Project Controls Team in development of the cost spread and cash flows.
  • Participate in proposal development, commercial alignment and project kickoff processes.
  • Supervise and train junior personnel in all aspects of cost reporting.
  • Lead the set up and maintenance of the progress measurement system.
  • Implement and support the Change Management process.
  • Lead change management efforts, including building of cost estimates and apply or manage amendments to the contract.
  • Lead project reviews conducted with the client and internal management.
  • Support the development and implementation of the Project Risk and Opportunity process.
  • Participate or lead the weekly and monthly cost and schedule review meetings.
  • Manage and maintain good client relations.
  • Actively look for areas of improvement on project and company standards.
  • Create Weekly / Monthly / Quarterly Reports.  
  • Assist in resource planning, recruiting, mentoring, and evaluations.
Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or Construction Management is preferred or
  • Ten plus (10+) years of experience in Project Controls.
  • Must have experience in a large-scale mega-project in Oil & Gas and Offshore Construction.
  • Highly competent in the use of critical project management concepts such as EVM, project planning, risk analysis, and progress measurement).
  • Experienced in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Project Management Professional is a plus.
  • Understanding of Cost and Progress management systems is a plus Work independently with little or no supervision.
  • Great communication and presentation skills, both written and spoken.
  • Experienced in both Cost and Schedule with a focus on Cost Management.
  • Understand the relationship between estimating, cost management, progress, schedule, and project accounting.

title: tecnico(a) manutencao mecanica pleno
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.
Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.
Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo (B3) e Nova Iorque (NYSE).

Conhecimentos especificos:

Description

Você na Deloitte

Os líderes da Deloitte vivem o nosso propósito: gerar impactos positivos. Energizam, empoderam, conectam, interagem, reagem e pensam de formas diferentes. Por isso, buscamos pessoas que são inspiradoras, criam ambientes diversos, influenciam uma cultura colaborativa e, com isso, entregam valor. Nossa liderança é peça-chave para o nosso crescimento.

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando Gerente no time de Finance Transformation, que terá a responsabilidade de liderar iniciativas estratégicas de melhoria contínua e digitalização dos processos de negócio, garantindo maior eficiência, escalabilidade e alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais. Este(a) profissional terá o papel de agir como ponte entre as áreas de negócio, tecnologia e liderança executiva, promovendo uma cultura de inovação orientada a dados. Atuará com:

  • Process Mining: Extração e análise de dados de sistemas de TI para mapear e visualizar processos reais, identificando ineficiências e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Simulação de Processos: Criação de modelos digitais dos processos empresariais para testar cenários e prever impactos de mudanças.
  • Predição de Processos: Uso de algoritmos de IA para antecipar comportamentos e resultados dos processos, permitindo ações proativas.
  • Identificação Inteligente de Oportunidades: Aplicação de técnicas avançadas para detectar áreas com potencial de melhoria ou inovação.
  • Descoberta Automatizada de Processos: Utilização de ferramentas para identificar e mapear processos sem a necessidade de intervenção manual.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.

Requirements

O que precisa para você se candidatar à vaga?

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia, Administração, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em consultoria (Big Four, boutiques de estratégia ou transformação), com transformação de processos, melhoria contínua e/ou automação.
  • Experiência com Process Mining (ex: Celonis, UiPath Process Mining).

Desejáveis

  • Certificação Green/Black Belt, BPM, PMP ou similares.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de automação (RPA, IA, Power Platform, etc.).
Benefits

Desenvolvimento profissional

É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar


Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial

title: Port Captain
description:
A Petra Group está assessorando um cliente do setor de engenharia submarina na busca por um Port Captain altamente experiente, rigoroso em segurança e capaz de garantir excelência operacional em frota offshore. Se você conhece o peso da responsabilidade sobre uma embarcação e sabe liderar equipes marítimas em operações críticas, esta posição exige exatamente esse nível de maturidade técnica. 


Supervisão Operacional da Frota

  • Gerenciar a operação diária das embarcações, assegurando eficiência, segurança e cumprimento dos planos;

  • Monitorar KPIs, consumos, disponibilidade e performance operacional;

  • Validar relatórios, análises de risco e documentação de navegação.

Conformidade e Segurança Marítima

  • Garantir conformidade com STCW, ISM, ISPS, SOLAS e normas aplicáveis;

  • Conduzir inspeções internas e apoiar auditorias de classe, bandeira e cliente;

  • Gerenciar procedimentos de emergência e SMS.

Gestão de Tripulação

  • Coordenar escalas e movimentação de tripulantes;

  • Avaliar Masters, Chief Officers e engenheiros de bordo;

  • Implementar boas práticas e reforçar disciplina operacional.

Integridade Técnica e Manutenção

  • Suportar o time de manutenção na execução dos planos preventivos e corretivos;

  • Acompanhar docagens, reparos e inspeções de classe;

  • Garantir alta disponibilidade operacional.

Cliente e Projetos Offshore

  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e alinhamentos operacionais;

  • Garantir aderência das embarcações aos requisitos de engenharia submarina;

  • Acompanhar mobilização, certificações e documentação.

Operações Portuárias e Logística

  • Coordenar bunkering, suprimentos, cargas e equipamentos subsea;

  • Planejar movimentação de ROVs, spreads de mergulho e ferramentas especiais;

  • Gerenciar fornecedores e operadores portuários.


Requisitos


  • Formação em Náutica, Engenharia Naval ou afins;

  • Experiência prévia como Oficial de Náutica ou Master Mariner, preferencialmente no offshore;

  • Vivência com embarcações PSV, AHTS, MPSV, DSV ou similares;

  • Fluência em espanhol e/ou inglês é diferencial.

Certificação Marítima / Habilitações

  • COC (Certificate of Competency) válido para Oficial de Náutica ou Master Mariner;

  • STCW completo, incluindo:

    • Basic Safety Training (BST)

    • Advanced Fire Fighting (AFF)

    • Proficiency in Survival Craft and Rescue Boats (PSCRB)

    • Medical First Aid / Medical Care (conforme nível exigido)

    • GMDSS (quando aplicável)

  • Certificação ISM Code / Auditor Interno (desejável);

  • Certificação ISPS – SSO / CSO (altamente desejável);

  • HUET / BOSIET / FOET (dependendo da área de operação offshore);

  • Certificados de Familiarização com DP (DP Awareness desejável quando a frota utilizar DP).

Outras Certificações Relevantes

  • Atualizações de STCW (refresher);

  • Certificação de SMS / Gestão de Riscos (diferencial);

  • Cursos voltados a operações offshore e subsea (ROV, Diving Support, handling de cargas especiais) serão considerados diferencial competitivo.


Benefícios


  • Salário compatível com o mercado offshore;

  • Bônus por performance;

  • Plano de saúde + seguro de vida;

  • Ajuda de custo para viagens e inspeções (diárias/per diem);

  • Alimentação e transporte (ou reembolso);

  • Hospedagem nas operações fora da base;

  • Reciclagens e certificações STCW/HUET custeadas;

  • Oportunidades de crescimento para Marine Superintendent, Fleet Manager ou posições de gestão operacional.

title: Operador de Sala de Controle II
description:
A Eneva em Rio de Janeiro  - RJ quer você no time #VemSerEneva  

Se você quer atuar como Operador de Sala de Controle II  temos um novo desafio para você

Principais responsabilidades:

Responsável pela operação remota das instalações, liberações
em tempo real e interface a área de Tempo Real do ONS e outros agentes de
geração, transmissão e distribuição.

- Operar remotamente as instalações da planta, sendo essas
instalações de fontes renováveis e interlocução de usinas termelétricas (gás,
carvão e óleo), de forma a garantir o funcionamento seguro e otimizado dos
equipamentos e processos, seguindo as instruções estabelecidas;

- Interlocução com os agentes da malha de gás;- Analisar em
tempo real as variáveis inerentes ao processo de produção de energia, através
de alarmes e gráficos de tendência, cumprimentos em tempo real das várias
instruções de operação da área de engenharia ou de planos de emergência, com
decisões sistêmicas visando a segurança das pessoas, meio ambiente, das
instalações e da continuidade da produção e sua eficiência;

- Orientar os operadores de campo, nas várias manobras em
tempo real e das inspeções necessárias na operação das usinas;

- Analisar os riscos nas solicitações de intervenções sendo
elas: SGI, AS, SM, LOTO, MO, AI, ATEIE, entre outras de necessidade em tempo
real;

- Interpretar a lógica de controle e automação, diagramas de
fluxo, entre outros desenhos dos sistemas de operação da planta, de acordo com
as instruções dos manuais técnicos dos equipamentos;

- Preencher as planilhas de controle interno do processo de
acordo com os procedimentos definidos;

- Monitorar o comportamento dos equipamentos nos monitores
de controle, verificando a existência de qualquer tipo de anomalia (falha ou
mau funcionamento);

- Desligar e reiniciar a planta de produção e sistema de
segurança e utilidades quando necessário, de acordo com os procedimentos e
parâmetros operacionais da planta;

- Informar a supervisão, através de registro em livro de
turno e/ou Relatório Diário da Operação, todas as ocorrências de incidentes
técnicos ou de segurança, durante o seu turno de trabalho;

- Realizar a passagem de turno para outro operador, devendo
ser efetuada com excelência para que seja possível a continuidade dos processos
que estão ocorrendo nas instalações;

- Contribuir para otimizar a operação da planta de produção
em busca de melhores condições operacionais, através de uma comunicação direta,
objetiva e consoante as orientações da supervisão;

- Realizar comunicação via fonia, utilizando os meios
disponibilizados pela área, deve ser uma comunicação, clara, objetiva e formal,
utilizando sempre o alfabeto fonético para melhor entendimento;

- Efetuar a identificação de problemas nos equipamentos,
solicitar a manutenção corretiva e preventiva sempre que necessário através da
abertura de solicitações de serviço e realizar comunicação imediata com o
supervisor quando identificado;

- Apoiar a supervisão com informações técnicas e da operação
sempre que necessário, bem como alimentar indicadores com dados relativos as
atividades de sua responsabilidade;

- Manter o bom relacionamento entre as equipes de manutenção
e operação e a colaboração com outras equipes de operação;

- Garantir que os dados que sejam imputados em tempo real,
estejam corretos para uma colaboração e trabalho com a equipe de pós operação;

- Detectar problemas e falhas em equipamentos e sistemas de
toda a planta via sala de controle;

- Prestar suporte remoto através dos meios disponibilizados
pela área para emergências junto a equipe de manutenção e HSE das instalações
operadas;

- Performar suas atividades de acordo com as normas da
empresa, de segurança, de saúde, de higiene e da segurança do trabalho;

- Domínio de sistema de Supervisão e Controle;

Desejável:

- Domínio de conceitos de geração solar;

- Conceitos de geração térmica;

- Proteções Elétricas;

- Conceitos Elétricos;

- Funcionamento dos Equipamentos da Subestação (TP, TC,
Transformador de Potência);

- Interpretação de Diagramas;

- Elaboração de Sequência de Manobras;

Para se candidatar, você precisa de:

- Conhecer de rotinas e procedimentos operacionais de ONS;

- Conhecimento avançado de pacote office;

- Curso técnico concluído em TÉCNICO ELETROTÉCNICO e CFT ou CRT ativo.

title: Analista de FP&A
description:
Somos uma empresa global de e-commerce em rápido crescimento, desenvolvendo e gerenciando marcas próprias para venda na Amazon, com operações nos EUA, Europa, Reino Unido e México. Buscamos um(a) Analista de FP&A para fortalecer nosso time financeiro e apoiar nossa estratégia de expansão.

Missão do Cargo:
Transformar dados financeiros em insights acionáveis para apoiar a tomada de decisão, sendo responsável por projeções financeiras (Forecast), controle orçamentário, análise de rentabilidade (P&L) e modelagem de novos negócios.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Liderar a análise e atualização semanal do Fluxo de Caixa (CashFlow), identificando riscos e oportunidades de capital de giro;
Preencher e analisar criticamente scorecards financeiros e operacionais, monitorando KPIs de liquidez e performance por marketplace;
Participar da construção do orçamento anual (Budget) e acompanhar o realizado vs. orçado, analisando desvios e apoiando gestores na correção de rota;
Analisar relatórios de rentabilidade por SKU, marca, canal e marketplace;
Construir e analisar modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira (ex: Payback, VPL, TIR) para novos produtos, marcas e expansão de mercado.

Requirements

Experiência sólida em FP&A, Controladoria ou funções analíticas financeiras.
Excel avançado/Expert (mandatório).
Capacidade comprovada em modelagem financeira.
Perfil altamente analítico, orientado a dados.
Experiência com BI & Dashboards (Power BI, Google Looker Studio, etc.).
Proatividade, organização e boa comunicação.
Inglês avançado (conversação, leitura e escrita).

Diferenciais:

Experiência prévia em e-commerce, varejo digital ou Amazon Sellers.
Conhecimento em contabilidade ou finanças internacionais (ex: VAT/GST, múltiplas moedas).
Experiência com ferramentas de análise de dados (SQL, Python).
